description: Contract for the kiosk Maps feature. ChatWonder uses this to understand how to preview event locations, show directions, and what context the Maps page sends back.

locationShape.query: string — human-readable address or place name as spoken by the user
locationShape.label: string — display label shown on the map pin (usually eventName)
locationShape.resolvedAddress: string | null — geocoded address; null until resolved by Maps feature

actions.description: Pin the event location on the map and center the view on it. Triggered automatically after event-setup confirmation.

payload.query: string — location as spoken by the user in event-setup
payload.label: string — eventName used as the map pin label

actions.description: Display turn-by-turn or overview directions from the kiosk to the event location
Reset the map to its default state (remove all pins and directions)

pageContext.description: Fields sent as collectedData / pageContext from the Maps page with every chatwonder_input

fields.pinnedLocation: locationShape | null — the currently pinned location, or null if no pin is set
fields.directionsActive: boolean — true if a directions route is currently displayed on the map

dataFlow.action: maps_preview_location dispatched by ChatWonder → Maps feature geocodes the query and pins it on the map
